description_en: The stone memorial pillar stands on the side of the motorable road linking Lekhagāũ to Birendranagar, near the settlement of Rāmrīkaḍā.The dimensions of the pillar are 170 x 56 x 21 cm.Although the pillar is inscribed, the (devanāgarī) text is currently not readable. Yogi Naraharinath mentions a memorial pillar in Rāmrīkaḍā (Naraharinath 1956, 2.1. p. 173, see alsoSharma 2012, p. 129). He provided a reading of the inscription where the date of installation of the pillar is ŚS 1037 (1115 CE). It remains unclear if the pillar mentioned by Naraharinath is the same as this one. Likewise, Prayag Raj Sharma raised the fact that Naraharinath's reading itself remains very doubtful (Sharma 1972, p. 42).Stone pillars were erected throughout the Karnali Basin from the 13th to the 17th century. They are installed to honor the memory of deceased persons, mostly warriors. Despite being different in shape, the Rāmrīkaḍā pillar contains decorative patterns of volutes that are very similar to those from the nearby pillar in Lekhagāũ (SRK0071-001), which is dated of 1318-1320 CE. On top the pillar is a hourglass-like motif yet unseen in any other memorial pillar. For these conflicting reasons the antiquity of the pillar can only be estimated between the 12th and the 14th century.
description_ne: यो कसैको स्मृतिस्वरूप बनाइएको खम्बा राम्रीकडागाउँ नजिकै लेखगाउँबाट वीरेन्द्रनगर जाने सडक बाटोको छेवैम अवस्थित छ । यसको नाप १७० x ५६ x २१ सिन्टिमिटर छ । खम्बामा देवनागरी लिपिमा अभिलेख पनि कुँदिएको छ तर अहिले यो पढन सकिने अवस्थाको छैन । योगी नरहरिनाथले राम्रीकडाको एउटा कुनै खम्बाको बारेमा उल्लेख गरेका छन् (हेर्नुहवस्Naraharinath 1956, 2.1. p. 173, रSharma 2012, p. 129) । उनले खम्बामा भएको अभिलेख पनि पढेका छन् र अभिलेखमा खम्बा गाडिएको मिति शक सम्वत् १०३७ (सन् १११५) उल्लेख गरिएको छ । तर नरिहरिनाथले उल्लेख गरेको खम्बा यही खम्बा हो अथवा अर्कै कुनै हो स्पष्ट किटेर भन्न सकिने बलियो आधार छैन । प्रयागराज शर्मा अनुसार नरहरिनाथले पढेको अभिलेखको पाठमा त्रुटीहरू हुनसक्ने प्रशस्त सम्भावना छ, हेर्नुहवस् (Sharma 1972, p. 42) । यो राम्रीकडा खम्बा लेखगाउँ खम्बा (SRK0071-001) संग मिल्दो जुल्दो छ र यो लेखगाउँ खम्बा सन् १३१८-१३२० को हो । त्यसैले यो राम्रीकडा खम्बा ईशाको बाह्रौंदेखि चौधौं शताब्दीभित्र गाडिएको हुन सक्ने अनुमान गर्न सकिन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: The pillar contains at least 7 lines of inscription in Devanagari script. The content of the text is not readable because of the heavy erosion of the stone. Yogi Naraharinath provided a reading of an inscribed pillar from Rāmrīkaḍā but it reamins difficult to ascertain if this is the pillar in question (Naraharinath 1956, 2.1. p. 173). The text provided by Naraharinath is:Oṁ swosti śri sāke 1037 vaishākhe māse 8 titḥau vivida...śwosti...jayutra malla va da kṣhe rāja...vakṣhe...putra jayakṣhe rājādhiraja jayakṣhe malla deva śri...rāgṇyi satya rupā dei sapatnikasya śri vishnuja putrasya mahārāja... subhamastu(transliteration published inSharma 2012, p. 129)
